description_en: Queries a list of devices based on device status
description_zh: 调用该接口根据设备状态查询设备列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-by-status --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --status 1 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfm4l5tcwd000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceByStatus

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device status. Valid values:

0: inactive.
1: online.
3: offline.
8: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设备状态。 可选值：

0：未激活。
1：在线。
3：离线。
8：已禁用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number from which to start displaying the results
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Specifies the number of records to display on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The request parameter ResourceGroupId is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

SimpleDeviceInfo.description_en: The list of device information (SimpleDeviceInfo) returned if the call was successful
SimpleDeviceInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备信息列表（SimpleDeviceInfo）

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the device was created, in GMT format
GmtCreate.description_zh: 设备创建时的时间，GMT格式

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the device information was last modified, in GMT format
GmtModified.description_zh: 设备信息最后一次修改时的时间，GMT格式

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

Status.description_en:
The device status. Valid values:

UNACTIVE: inactive.

ONLINE: online.

OFFLINE: offline.

DISABLE: disabled

设备状态。 取值：

UNACTIVE：未激活。

ONLINE：在线。

OFFLINE：离线。

DISABLE：已禁用

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the device was created, in UTC format
UtcCreate.description_zh: 设备创建时的时间，UTC格式

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the device information was last modified, in UTC format
UtcModified.description_zh: 设备信息最后一次修改时的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageSize.description_en: The number of devices displayed per page

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

true: The call was successful.

表示是否调用成功。
